text: You see a dim glowing computer.
source_text: You see a dim glowing computer.

text: 你看到一台黯淡的发光的电脑。
source_text: 你看到一台黯淡的发光的电脑。

text: There is a trickle of power coming in. Most of the power seems# to have been routed to maintain the few systems which are still# semi-functioning.
source_text:
There is a trickle of power coming in. Most of the power seems
# to have been routed to maintain the few systems which are still
# semi-functioning.

text: 有一股电力涌入。电力的大多数看上去已经被发送去维持少数仍然半工作中的系统。
source_text: 有一股电力涌入。电力的大多数看上去已经被发送去维持少数仍然半工作中的系统。

text: You notice nothing unusual.
source_text: You notice nothing unusual.

text: 你没注意到什么不同的。
source_text: 你没注意到什么不同的。

text: This computer is making a weird humming noise.
source_text: This computer is making a weird humming noise.

text: 这台电脑正在发出不可思议的嗡嗡噪声。
source_text: 这台电脑正在发出不可思议的嗡嗡噪声。

text: A monitor connected to this computer is printing the word# 'System failure.' over and over.
source_text:
A monitor connected to this computer is printing the word
# 'System failure.' over and over.

text: 一台连接到这台电脑的监视器正在反复地显示着文字“系统故障”。
source_text: 一台连接到这台电脑的监视器正在反复地显示着文字“系统故障”。

text: This computer appears to have been attacked by a ghoul.
source_text: This computer appears to have been attacked by a ghoul.

text: 这台电脑看来曾被一个僵尸攻击。
source_text: 这台电脑看来曾被一个僵尸攻击。

text: Lights are flashing on this computer but it seems random to you.
source_text: Lights are flashing on this computer but it seems random to you.

text: 这台电脑上的灯在闪着，但是它对你来说看上去很混乱。
source_text: 这台电脑上的灯在闪着，但是它对你来说看上去很混乱。

text: This computer gives you a harmless shock when you touch it.
source_text: This computer gives you a harmless shock when you touch it.

text: 当你触碰这台电脑的时候它给了你一下无害的电击。
source_text: 当你触碰这台电脑的时候它给了你一下无害的电击。

text: Upon inspection you notice that this computer has been used# as a home by rats.
source_text:
Upon inspection you notice that this computer has been used
# as a home by rats.

text: 在检查后你注意到这台电脑已经被老鼠当作窝了。
source_text: 在检查后你注意到这台电脑已经被老鼠当作窝了。

text: Random numbers are printing across a screen connected to this system.
source_text: Random numbers are printing across a screen connected to this system.

text: 随机数正在通过一个连接到这个系统的屏幕显示出来。
source_text: 随机数正在通过一个连接到这个系统的屏幕显示出来。

text: This computer is making the worst noise you have ever heard. The# word 'Jared' is displayed on the monitor.
source_text:
This computer is making the worst noise you have ever heard. The
# word 'Jared' is displayed on the monitor.

text: 这台电脑正在发出你曾听过的最糟糕的噪声。文字“加雷德”被显示在监视器上。
source_text: 这台电脑正在发出你曾听过的最糟糕的噪声。文字“加雷德”被显示在监视器上。

text: Half of this computer is black and charred from an old fire.
source_text: Half of this computer is black and charred from an old fire.

text: 这台电脑的一半是黑的，是被过去的一场火烧焦的。
source_text: 这台电脑的一半是黑的，是被过去的一场火烧焦的。
